Hey, so i saw someone post about a type of work flow, and its pretty clever, and so we will try it right now on a real set of code that has been bothering me. the content browser in the @cart/editor/ needs a redo on its approach, and we want to end up using this as our build menus and texture/color picking menus, etc. because truly all those systems as they stand now, are about to explode in their asset stores and such and its gonna be just a pain in our ass, and the fact we have the content browser as a started thing now, just not being used exactly for this, is exactly where we can start.


the idea is rather simple. its to just send you an image of concept art that i have refined to my liking. From here, il match it with the current state of it. After each run, il follow up with the same concept art image and the most current state. we rinse and repeat til they are the same. sound good?

events.text: Concept-art matching loop is live: round 1 landed as req_3135 (sha 7b81266a5). Keeping this req in doing as the umbrella for the rinse-and-repeat rounds.
